subject: linguistics

source.document: Course calendar and syllabus, Prof. Norvin W. Richards
source.track: University undergraduate · no prerequisites · 26 lectures surveying the core components of grammar and language in use

note: Units follow the OCW calendar's lecture sequence: morphology, phonetics and phonology, syntax and semantics, then language in society, history and acquisition. The core-component lectures anchor the foundational and intermediate lessons; the advanced and expert lessons extend the later lectures and the syntax sequence into the atlas's deeper treatments. Unit 12 extends the calendar to the computational study of language, which the course touches only in passing.
